🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No automated asylum refusal decisions without human caseworker review and approval
  • ❌ No biometric surveillance of asylum seekers beyond statutory border security purposes
  • ❌ No algorithmic detention decisions without individual human risk assessment
  • ❌ No modern slavery identification used for immigration enforcement against victims
  • ❌ No sharing of asylum seeker location data with immigration enforcement without safeguarding assessment
  • ❌ No automated age assessment used as sole determinant without human expert verification
